children: DingoBlu Financial, Inc., a financial technology company developing a mobile-first platform for personal financial products, today announced a strategic partnership with MVB Bank, Inc. The partnership represents an important milestone as DingoBlu prepares to introduce its platform and suite of financial products.

DingoBlu is a Visa fintech partner, and its debit card program will run on the Visa network through its bank partner, MVB Bank. Through the relationship, MVB Bank will provide the regulated banking infrastructure supporting eligible DingoBlu deposit products and related banking services, while DingoBlu will provide the technology platform and digital experience through which clients can access and manage their accounts.

DingoBlu is developing a streamlined mobile experience designed to help clients manage their everyday finances more conveniently. Planned offerings include checking and savings account options, digital account-management tools and Visa debit card access. Specific product features, rates, fees, terms and availability will be shared closer to launch.

“Partnering with MVB Bank brings us one step closer to introducing the DingoBlu experience,” said Thomas Ulry, Chief Executive Officer of DingoBlu Financial, Inc. “MVB’s experience supporting financial technology companies, combined with our focus on creating a simple and intuitive client experience, provides a strong foundation as we prepare to bring DingoBlu to market.”

“MVB is proud to partner with DingoBlu as they prepare to bring their innovative financial platform to market. Our experience supporting fintech companies, combined with our banking expertise and regulatory capabilities, provides a strong foundation for their growth,” said Larry F. Mazza, President and CEO of MVB Financial Corp. “We look forward to helping DingoBlu deliver a simple, seamless financial experience for its clients.”

The partnership brings together DingoBlu’s technology platform and client-focused design with MVB Bank’s banking capabilities and regulatory infrastructure. DingoBlu’s participation as a Visa fintech partner further supports the debit card experience, with DingoBlu debit cards operating on the Visa network through MVB Bank.
Additional information about DingoBlu’s products, features and availability will be announced closer to launch.

Product availability, features, rates, fees, terms and eligibility requirements are subject to change. Banking services will be provided by MVB Bank, Inc., Member FDIC. Visa is a registered trademark of Visa.

Based in Charlotte, North Carolina, DingoBlu Financial, Inc. is a financial technology company developing a mobile-first platform for personal financial products. DingoBlu is focused on delivering an intuitive digital experience that helps clients access, manage and understand their finances.

DingoBlu Financial, Inc. is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services will be provided by MVB Bank, Inc., Member FDIC. DingoBlu is a Visa fintech partner, and its debit card program operates on the Visa network through MVB Bank.

MVB Financial Corp. (Nasdaq: MVBF) is an innovative bank powering Fintech solutions in payments, card issuance, sponsorship lending and online gaming programs for leading Fintech companies nationwide, while providing traditional retail and commercial banking services within established markets. MVB’s comprehensive platform includes money movement solutions across all modalities and embedded finance capabilities. MVB combines proven Fintech builder/incubator capabilities, innovative culture, regulatory expertise, core banking and AI-driven operational efficiency to enable Fintech partners to navigate complex regulatory requirements while accelerating time-to-market.
